# Air-gapped install procedure: verify the tagged release-manifest signature,
# then use scripts/mirror-release.py to resolve the complete immutable copy
# plan, verify destination digests, sign the mapping, and emit Helm overrides.
# See docs/airgapped-install.md for the full operator procedure.

guide.interpretation: Prescription summaries in decision-matrix.md; guide bytes retained temporarily, not copied into repository.

limitations: W00 inventories selected source inputs; W01 must resolve latest stable/digests/platforms and close recursively rendered asset graphs.
Go graph is declared go.mod requirements; npm graph is committed lock graph, not a fresh install/audit.
No application-catalog or Charlie artifact was downloaded or verified; their pinned producer/consumer inputs are source-bound.
